name: addWatchlistProduct
description: Add a listing to the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId so they can follow it and, with notifications on (the default), hear about changes. A listing already on the watchlist returns CONFLICT; subscription tier limits apply.

notifications.description: Whether to be notified about changes to the listing (default true).

productListingId.description: ID of the listing (`pl_…`) to add.

name: createUserAddress
description: Save a new private address with a label and its location in the signed-in user's address book; Aura Historia resolves the location for shipping estimates. Each call creates a new address, so repeating a call that timed out can create a duplicate.

addressText.description: Free-text address; address-book entries require it.

referenceRelease.description: Version of the ISO 3166 code list the codes come from; `iso-codes-4.20.1` is the only accepted value.

addressText.description: Free-text address; required for address-book entries.

geography.description: Where the address is: the reference release, the address text (required) and optionally country, subdivision and postal code.

label.description: Name of the address in the address book.

name: createUserSearchFilter
description: Save a listing search for the signed-in user. Aura Historia matches new listings against it in the background and, with notifications on (the default), notifies the user, so matches appear later. Subscription tier limits apply. Each call creates a new saved search, so repeating a call that timed out can create a duplicate. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

AcceptShippingDestinationData.description:
Optional acceptance guard. The submitted country must equal the authorized address or
preference's asserted country. Neither the reference nor provider evidence is retained.

oneOf.description: Compare with the country of one of the user's saved addresses.
Compare with the country of the user's stored browsing destination.

amount.description: Amount as an integer in the currency's minor unit (EUR cents; JPY whole yen).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount is in.

max.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

min.description: Start of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, at most 100; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

distanceOrder.description: Order results by distance from `origin`, `ASC` (nearest first) or `DESC`; requires `origin`.

mode.description: Which locations count when measuring distance: `STRICT` (default) only exact premises, `APPROXIMATE` also street, locality and representative points; `APPROXIMATE` needs `origin` with `radius` or `distanceOrder`.

origin.description: Point that `radius` and `distanceOrder` measure from; required by either of them.

unit.description: Unit of `amount`: one of MILES, YARDS, FEET, INCHES, KILOMETERS, METERS, CENTIMETERS, MILLIMETERS, NAUTICAL_MILES.

radius.description: Only listings within this distance of `origin`, at most 20,000 km.

subdivisions.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, at most 100, that belong to `countries` when those are given; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

max.description: Highest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

min.description: Lowest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

auctionId.description: Only listings that belong to these auctions, given as auction IDs (`auc_…`).

availability.description: Only listings in one of these exact availability states; combined with `orderability`, a listing must satisfy both.

created.description: Range on the listing's creation time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

currency.description: Currency prices are returned in and `price` is interpreted in, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

enhancedSearchDescription.description: Optional natural-language description that refines the ranking of `productQuery` results. Only effective together with `productQuery`; on its own it returns unranked, unrelated results.

excludeListingSourceId.description: Leave out listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

excludeProductListingId.description: Listing IDs (`pl_…`) to leave out of the results.

geography.description: Where listings are located, by country, subdivision or distance from a point; every member given must hold.

includeUnspecifiedAvailability.description: Also include listings that state no availability (default false).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text and of the titles `productQuery` is matched against, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

listingSourceId.description: Only listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

lotBiddingOpens.description: Range on the time bidding on the lot opens, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

lotScheduledCloses.description: Range on the lot's scheduled closing time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

orderability.description: Only listings whose availability falls into one of these orderability groups; combined with `availability`, a listing must satisfy both.

price.description: Price range in the request's `currency`, with both bounds inclusive. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

productQuery.description: Keyword phrases matched against listing titles; every word of one phrase must match, and a listing matches when any phrase does.

shipping.description: Only listings whose advertised shipping terms meet these conditions for a destination country; every member given must hold.

updated.description: Range on the listing's last update time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

collectionOffered.description: Only listings that offer collection in person; the only shipping condition that works without a destination country.

destination.description: Country the listing must ship to, as `{"kind":"COUNTRY","country":"DE"}`; `{"kind":"NONE"}` sets no destination.

interpretation.description: `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_V1` (default) or `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_FX_V1`, which values `maximumPerItem` in its own currency at the request's exchange rates and requires `maximumPerItem`.

maximumPerItem.description: Highest acceptable shipping price per item, in the amount's own currency; requires a `destination` country. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

referenceRelease.description: Version of the ISO 3166 code list the country code comes from; `iso-codes-4.20.1` is the only accepted value and the default.

service.description: Shipping service code the terms must include, as free text of at most 128 characters; requires a `destination` country.

acceptShippingDestination.description: Optional guard confirming the shipping destination: the filter's shipping country must equal the country of the referenced address or browsing preference.

name.description: Name of the saved search, at most 255 characters (longer names are cut off).

search.description: Criteria a listing must meet to match this saved search; the members are those of the listing search.

name: deleteNotification
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's notifications by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

name: deleteNotifications
description: Permanently delete every notification of the signed-in user, including those beyond the listed page. Takes no arguments. Returns an empty object.

name: deleteUserAddress
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal its current version. If the address is the browsing destination, that destination is cleared too. Returns an empty object.

expectedVersion.description: Current version from the last read; a stale version returns CONFLICT.

name: deleteUserSearchFilter
description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

name: deleteWatchlistProduct
description: Remove a listing from the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId. Returns an empty object; a listing that is not on the watchlist returns NOT_FOUND, also after an earlier call removed it.

name: getAuction
description: Get one auction by its auctionId: name, provider, format, schedule, reported status, reported and visible lot counts, and the link to its catalogue at the provider.

name: getAuctionCatalogue
description: List the lots of one auction by its auctionId in catalogue order, as listings in the requested language and currency with shipping details. Pass the returned searchAfter object as a JSON string to get the next page. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

currency.description: Currency of the returned prices, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

pageSize.description: Number of lots per page, from 1 to 100 (default 21); values outside that range are clamped.

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: its `searchAfter` object serialized as a JSON string, passed back exactly as returned.

name: getBrowsingDestination
description: Get the destination Aura Historia uses to estimate shipping while the signed-in user browses: NONE, one of their saved addresses (ADDRESS) or a country with an optional postal code (COUNTRY_POSTAL), with its version.

name: getProductListing
description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingId: text, prices, images, provider, availability, auction and shipping, in the requested language and currency. Use it when the user wants more than a search result shows. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

name: getProductListingByTitleSlug
description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingTitleSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia listing page URL (/products/{slug}). Returns the same details as the lookup by productListingId. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

currency.description: Currency of the returned prices, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

name: getProductListingHistory
description: Get the complete history of one listing by its productListingId: when it was first seen and every recorded change, in event order. Use it for questions about price development or past changes. With currency, each price is also converted at the exchange rate of its event. Returns every event in one result; a history too large for one response fails instead of being truncated. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

inputSchema.description: Existing optional REST history presentation query, reused by MCP arguments.

currency.description: Currency to also show each price in, converted at the exchange rate of its event, as an ISO 4217 code; without it only the source prices are returned.

name: getPublicListingSourceBySlug
description: Get the public profile of one provider (a dealer, auction house, marketplace or auction platform) by its listingSourceSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL (/shops/{slug}): name, operator, website and image.

listingSourceSlugId.description: Slug ID of the provider, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL.

name: getPublicOverview
description: Get the latest calculated statistics of the Aura Historia catalogue: live listings, listings added in the last seven days, countries, languages and indexed providers by type, with the time they were calculated. Takes no arguments.

name: getSimilarProductListings
description: Find listings similar to one listing, identified by its productListingId. Returns up to `size` neighbours (default 20; values outside 1 to 50 are clamped) in the requested language and currency. EMBEDDING_PENDING means the listing is not yet prepared for comparison and a later call can succeed; READY with an empty list means nothing similar was found. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

inputSchema.description: Existing presentation query used by listing detail and similarity reads.

currency.description: Currency of the returned prices, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

size.description: Number of similar listings to return, from 1 to 50 (default 20); values outside that range are clamped.

name: getUserAccount
description: Get the signed-in user's Aura Historia account: email, name, language, currency and measurement unit, content preference, marketing consent, subscription tier and role.

name: getUserAddress
description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved addresses by addressId, with its resolved location and the attribution of the geocoding provider.

name: getUserSearchFilter
description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved searches by userSearchFilterId, with its criteria, state and notification settings. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

name: getUserSearchFilters
description: List all of the signed-in user's saved searches with their criteria, state and notification settings. Takes no arguments. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

name: getWatchlistProductListings
description: List the listings on the signed-in user's watchlist with their full details and notification settings, in the requested language and currency. Pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

language.description: Language of the returned listing text, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: its `searchAfter` array of [RFC 3339 watchlist creation time, listing ID] serialized as a JSON string, passed back exactly as returned.

size.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100 (default 21); values outside that range are clamped.

name: listAuctions
description: List auctions of the auction houses and platforms that Aura Historia indexes, filtered by provider, format, reported status and schedule period and sorted by creation or schedule time. Use it to find upcoming, running or past auctions. A schedule period needs timeRole, from and to together, and sorting by schedule time needs timeRole. Pass the returned searchAfter object as a JSON string to get the next page.

from.description: Start of the schedule period for `timeRole`, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset; give it together with `to` and `timeRole`.

listingSourceId.description: Only auctions of this provider, as a listing source ID (`ls_…`).

pageSize.description: Number of auctions per page, from 1 to 100 (default 21); values outside that range are clamped.

reportedStatus.description: Only auctions with this status as the provider reports it.

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: its `searchAfter` object serialized as a JSON string, passed back exactly as returned with the same filters and sort.

sort.description: `created` (default) orders by creation time; `scheduled` orders by the `timeRole` instant and requires `timeRole`.

timeRole.description: Schedule instant that `from` and `to` filter on and `sort=scheduled` orders by; required with `from`/`to` and with `sort=scheduled`.

to.description: End of the schedule period for `timeRole`, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset; give it together with `from` and `timeRole`.

name: listNotifications
description: List the signed-in user's notifications, such as watchlist changes and new saved-search matches, with each listing as it was when notified, in the requested language. Returns up to size notifications (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

name: listSearchFilterMatches
description: List the listings that matched one of the signed-in user's saved searches, oldest match first, in the requested language and currency. Matching runs in the background, so an empty first page means there are no matches yet. Returns up to size matches (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAfter array unchanged to get the next page. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

language.description: Language of the returned listing text, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: its `searchAfter` array of [RFC 3339 match time, listing ID], passed back exactly as returned.

size.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100 (default 21); values outside that range are clamped.

name: listUserAddresses
description: List the signed-in user's saved addresses with their resolved locations. Returns up to limit addresses (default 25, 1 to 100); pass the returned next as after to get the next page.

after.description: Continuation from the previous page: its `next` address ID, passed back exactly as returned.

limit.description: Number of addresses per page, from 1 to 100 (default 25).

name: patchWatchlistProduct
description: Turn notifications for a watched listing on or off, or pause (INACTIVE_BY_USER) or resume (ACTIVE) the entry. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). name: searchPublicListingSources

description: Mark every notification of the signed-in user as seen or unseen, including those beyond the listed page. Returns an empty object.

description: Mark one of the signed-in user's notifications as seen or unseen by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

currency.description: Preferred currency, as an ISO 4217 code; omit to keep it, null clears it.

firstName.description: First name; omit to keep it, null clears it.

language.description: Preferred language, as an ISO 639-1 code; omit to keep it, null clears it.

lastName.description: Last name; omit to keep it, null clears it.

measurementUnit.description: Preferred measurement unit system; omit to keep it, null clears it.

showUnassessedOrSensitiveContent.description: Whether listings with unassessed or sensitive content are shown; omit to keep it, null is rejected.

name: updateUserAddress
description: Replace the label and location of one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal the address's current version; a stale version returns CONFLICT. Returns the updated address.

addressText.description: Free-text address; address-book entries require it.

referenceRelease.description: Version of the ISO 3166 code list the codes come from; `iso-codes-4.20.1` is the only accepted value.

expectedVersion.description: Current version from the last read; a stale version returns CONFLICT.

addressText.description: Free-text address; required for address-book entries.

geography.description: New location of the address, replacing the current one entirely.

label.description: New name of the address, replacing the current one.

name: updateUserSearchFilter
description: Change the name, criteria, state or notification setting of one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears fields that can be cleared; availability, orderability and includeUnspecifiedAvailability change together. Matching against new criteria runs in the background. Returns the saved search. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

AcceptShippingDestinationData.description:
Optional acceptance guard. The submitted country must equal the authorized address or
preference's asserted country. Neither the reference nor provider evidence is retained.

oneOf.description: Compare with the country of one of the user's saved addresses.
Compare with the country of the user's stored browsing destination.

amount.description: Amount as an integer in the currency's minor unit (EUR cents; JPY whole yen).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount is in.

max.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

min.description: Start of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, at most 100; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

distanceOrder.description: Order results by distance from `origin`, `ASC` (nearest first) or `DESC`; requires `origin`.

mode.description: Which locations count when measuring distance: `STRICT` (default) only exact premises, `APPROXIMATE` also street, locality and representative points; `APPROXIMATE` needs `origin` with `radius` or `distanceOrder`.

origin.description: Point that `radius` and `distanceOrder` measure from; required by either of them.

unit.description: Unit of `amount`: one of MILES, YARDS, FEET, INCHES, KILOMETERS, METERS, CENTIMETERS, MILLIMETERS, NAUTICAL_MILES.

radius.description: Only listings within this distance of `origin`, at most 20,000 km.

subdivisions.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, at most 100, that belong to `countries` when those are given; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

max.description: Highest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

min.description: Lowest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

auctionId.description: Only listings that belong to these auctions, given as auction IDs (`auc_…`).

availability.description: Only listings in one of these exact availability states; combined with `orderability`, a listing must satisfy both.

created.description: Range on the listing's creation time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

currency.description: Currency prices are returned in and `price` is interpreted in, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

enhancedSearchDescription.description: Optional natural-language description that refines the ranking of `productQuery` results. Only effective together with `productQuery`; on its own it returns unranked, unrelated results.

excludeListingSourceId.description: Leave out listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

geography.description: Where listings are located, by country, subdivision or distance from a point; every member given must hold.

includeUnspecifiedAvailability.description: Also include listings that state no availability (default false).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text and of the titles `productQuery` is matched against, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

listingSourceId.description: Only listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

lotBiddingOpens.description: Range on the time bidding on the lot opens, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

lotScheduledCloses.description: Range on the lot's scheduled closing time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

orderability.description: Only listings whose availability falls into one of these orderability groups; combined with `availability`, a listing must satisfy both.

price.description: Price range in the request's `currency`, with both bounds inclusive. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

productQuery.description: Keyword phrases matched against listing titles; every word of one phrase must match, and a listing matches when any phrase does.

shipping.description: Only listings whose advertised shipping terms meet these conditions for a destination country; every member given must hold.

updated.description: Range on the listing's last update time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

collectionOffered.description: Only listings that offer collection in person; the only shipping condition that works without a destination country.

destination.description: Country the listing must ship to, as `{"kind":"COUNTRY","country":"DE"}`; `{"kind":"NONE"}` sets no destination.

interpretation.description: `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_V1` (default) or `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_FX_V1`, which values `maximumPerItem` in its own currency at the request's exchange rates and requires `maximumPerItem`.

maximumPerItem.description: Highest acceptable shipping price per item, in the amount's own currency; requires a `destination` country. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

referenceRelease.description: Version of the ISO 3166 code list the country code comes from; `iso-codes-4.20.1` is the only accepted value and the default.

service.description: Shipping service code the terms must include, as free text of at most 128 characters; requires a `destination` country.

acceptShippingDestination.description: Optional guard confirming the shipping destination: the filter's shipping country must equal the country of the referenced address or browsing preference.

name.description: New name, at most 255 characters (longer names are cut off); omit to keep the current name.

notifications.description: Whether matches trigger notifications; omit to keep the current setting.

search.description: Partial criteria: omitted members stay unchanged, null clears `enhancedSearchDescription`, `auctionId`, `price`, the date ranges and the availability query, and `availability`, `orderability` and `includeUnspecifiedAvailability` are given together or all null.

state.description: `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE_BY_USER`; omit to keep the current state, and activating a filter checks all its criteria against the current tier.
